column5: Description
Carved in the image of a prince who lost everything, this staff radiates the chill of a forgotten crown.
Formed in the shadow of Ashbound Hall, this axe was made to end the cursed hunger. Its edge drinks no blood-instead denying it entirely.
A healing staff enchanted by the power of Meridia, the Daedric Prince of Light.
Shaped from fallen trees that never grew in Tamriel, these boots creak with memories of a forest twisted by Coldharbour's will.
An enchanted ring, its band etched with the likeness of a menacing skull, eerily mirroring those found deep within Carapace Cavern.
Light enough for a silent step and sturdy enough for a storm-washed deck, these treads once graced the feet of the Bonnie Spriggan's fleet-footed crew.
A collection of coins and valuables from the vaults in Corelanya Manor.
A Coldharbour-imbued head covering found in Deetra Grotto.
Crafted for one who walks the skeins between planes, these gloves retain the touch of realms long departed.

column4: Forged to weather fang, flame, and claw, these gauntlets were given in thanks by a vampire hunter whose Daedric hound would have died without you.
Once meant to fell beasts in the wild, this maul now bears a heavier stain. The hunter offered it without protest, perhaps because it was never truly his to begin with.

column5: A glimmering pendant, bestowed upon those who triumph in the grand festivities and revels dedicated to Sanguine, the Daedric Prince of Pleasure.
Shaped for those who stood unshaken in the face of chaos, these pauldrons bear the heavy weight of duty even as they shield against steel.

column4: Carried by sworn protectors of the Fellowship, this mace symbolizes the vows made not to a place, but to the allies who march beside you.

column5: Its surface bears the scorched imprint of a Worm Cult mark-burned away, but not forgotten.
Though simple in form, this blade was honed with patience and purpose. The hermit claimed that the stone itself asked her to give it to one who showed kindness without demand.
Worn by those who scout ahead and strike first, this tunic offers freedom of movement without sacrificing the mark of the Fellowship.

column4: Favored by the Fellowship's forward scouts, this helm offers protection without hindering sight or stealth.

column5: Once used to teach healing arts in a hall now scarred by Daedric flame, this staff was spared when all else burned.
A special pair of shoal-tender gloves given as a show of trust and respect by the Tide-Born tribe.
Leg armor awarded by the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service at Shor's Stand.
Armored footwear awarded to members of the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service.

column4: Robes awarded to members of the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service.
Simple in design but laden with meaning, this ring bears the warmth of a fading light. Darien offered it not as a farewell, but as a vow. Wherever you walk, know that part of him walks with you.
A Daedric weapon, received as payment for assisting Captain Genevé Delitian.

column5: These light shoulder wraps once belonged to a soldier known for his bravery and his chronic inability to tell healing potions from painful poisons.
An ancient chestpiece once lost to the abandoned Argonian village of Tainted Leel.
A ring awarded to the "Most Adored" of the Blushing Brush.
Shoulderguards awarded to members of the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service.

column4: A weapon awarded to members of the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service.
A shield awarded to members of the Stirk Fellowship for outstanding service.
Forged from the combined crests of the Fellowship's founding orders, this necklace honors those who stood not for one banner, but for all.

column5: How this valuable Stirk Fellowship gear wound up in a pirate's possession is unknown, but it's all yours now.
A sharp Tide-Born blade utilized in Death-Dancer rituals all across Solstice.

column4: A sharp, keen dagger infused with the essence of Coldharbour.

column5: Fashioned from the wood of a Hist that speaks no more, this staff carries a quiet, watchful power.
Recovered from the depths of a forgotten chamber, this shield bears markings the researcher could not translate.
